name: Rocco Frank Petrillo
bioAdditions: As 'Rocco Petrillo' he survived his sister Josephine Castellano in November 1995 (S1).

sources.citation: Obituary, Josephine Castellano, The Arizona Republic (Phoenix), 29 Nov 1995 (clipping image attached to FamilySearch tree GQWT-QQ6, collection 'Arizona, Gila, Payson, Obituaries', ark 1:1:Q2WQ-L25P).
